### drawRough()

```ts
function drawRough(root?): () => void;
```

Draw every `[data-caps-rough]` element inside `root` (and `root` itself),
loading Rough.js on first use, and redraw each one when its size changes.
Returns a function that stops watching sizes. If Rough.js cannot load, the CSS
fallback stays.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type         | Default value |
| --------- | ------------ | ------------- |
| `root`    | `ParentNode` | `document`    |

#### Returns

() => `void`
